name: Facet
text: Use a dark theme with high-contrast interactive charts. It matches Manus’s competitive interface and Graphify’s central graph, making our tool feel familiar and professional. Trade-off: dark themes can strain eyes in bright rooms, but we’ll add a quick theme toggle to keep users comfortable.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes don’t just strain eyes—they fail in daylight or glare, and a toggle won’t fix that. A light theme with a single dark accent keeps readability high while borrowing Manus’s polish. Settle it by testing both in a bright room: if the dark theme forces users to squint or switch, the light theme wins.
